headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 22, 2026**
article:
The Minnesota Twins suffered a blowout loss to the Cleveland Guardians, while the New York Yankees secured a thrilling victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates. In other action, the Tampa Bay Rays dominated the Toronto Blue Jays, and the Boston Red Sox edged out the Baltimore Orioles in a closely contested matchup.

Top news saw the Twins fall to the Guardians in a 13-4 loss, with Petey Halpin leading the Guardians' offense with 3 hits, 2 home runs, and 3 RBIs. The Yankees secured a 5-8 victory over the Pirates, with Jazz Chisholm Jr. leading the Pirates' offense with 2 home runs and 5 RBIs. The Rays took down the Blue Jays 7-1, with Nick Fortes contributing to his 2-hit, 1-home run performance. The Red Sox rallied past the Orioles in a thrilling finish, with Christian Encarnacion-Strand leading the Orioles' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Jack Flaherty of the Detroit Tigers, who was placed on the 15-day injured list due to right flexor inflammation. The Texas Rangers also placed Jose Corniell on the 15-day injured list, while the Los Angeles Dodgers transferred Will Smith to the 60-day injured list due to neck inflammation. The Athletics placed Joshua Kuroda-Grauer on the 10-day injured list after undergoing ruptured testicle surgery, and Mark Leiter Jr. was placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to July 19, 2026, due to right hip impingement.

Several teams made notable roster moves, including the Los Angeles Dodgers acquiring Seth Halvorsen from the Colorado Rockies in exchange for Nick Frasso and Landyn Vidourek. The Athletics traded Aaron Civale to the Chicago Cubs for Aiden Moffett, and the Baltimore Orioles acquired Rudy Martin Jr. from the Kansas City Royals in exchange for cash.

top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins suffered a 13-4 loss to the Cleveland Guardians, with the Guardians' offense dominating the game. Petey Halpin led the Guardians' charge with 3 hits, 2 home runs, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Fall to Yankees in 8-5 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 5-8 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Jazz Chisholm Jr. leading the Pirates' offense with 2 home runs and 5 RBIs. Wilber Dotel pitched 3 scoreless innings for the Pirates, striking out 5 batters.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down Blue Jays 7-1**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured a convincing 7-1 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Nick Fortes leading the offense. Fortes hit a home run on a fly ball to left center field, contributing to his 2-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Rally Past Orioles in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox edged out the Baltimore Orioles 6-5, securing a hard-fought victory. Christian Encarnacion-Strand led the Orioles' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Fall Short in Thrilling Tiebreaker**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees edged out the Pittsburgh Pirates 0-0 in a closely contested game, securing the win. The Pirates ultimately came up short in a hard-fought matchup.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Shut Down Orioles in Thrilling Tiebreaker**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox secured a 0-0 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, claiming the win in a closely contested matchup. Zack Kelly earned the win for the Red Sox.

top_news.title: **Tigers Place Jack Flaherty on 15-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Detroit Tigers right-handed pitcher Jack Flaherty has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right flexor inflammation.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Acquire Halvorsen in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers have acquired RHP Seth Halvorsen from the Colorado Rockies in exchange for RHP Nick Frasso and OF Landyn Vidourek.
